annotations.text:
Rebuilt from the shipped source, not from a screenshot.
Every colour, size, radius and control height is lifted from globals.css, page.tsx, hero.tsx, site-chrome.tsx, cost-calculator.tsx, faq.tsx and demo-calendar.tsx.

Live here: the hero's date grid and time slots, the cost calculator's three sliders, and the FAQ accordion.
The widths the real media queries actually produce at 390: 18px gutters, single-column grids, 44px headline, footer stacked. Checked for horizontal overflow — there is none.
